source.figure_table: Results of the BCH-BB694 BCL11A-shmiR gene therapy pilot

context.intervention: BCL11A-shmiR gene therapy (autologous CD34+ cells transduced with BCH-BB694 lentiviral vector; ClinicalTrials.gov NCT03282656)

observation.unit: pg per cell (range across 6 patients; distinguishes total HbF, the fraction of positive cells, and directly measured per-cell HbF — design-spec seed 4)
observation.evidence_locator: Esrick et al., NEJM 384(3):205–215; PMID 33283990; 'RESULTS' — 'HbF per F-cell of 9.0 to 18.6 pg per cell'

note: Cross-readout within the same pilot (G4): HbF% (P-008), F-cell% (P-009), and HbF per F-cell (P-010).
